title: ophrys fuciflora subsp. andria
intro: Ophrys fuciflora subsp. andria, commonly known as the Bee Orchid, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys fuciflora subsp. andria include antioxidant, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Bee Orchid include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
